question: In a certain code language, MONDAY is written as ZBEOPN and MARCH is written as IDSBN. How will APRIL be written in the same language?
solution:
The English alphabetical order is given as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/138aecb2c1da53efabc5e180f14ca9311d5d8acbaf4e29017f8c36afbd2b8aaf.png] 

The logic followed here is-

For 'MONDAY is written as ZBEOPN ', we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0104e18b1d8a207e1165d903ee6a92dc3ce30ff128f7dfa8542dc371843bc11a.png] 

For 'MARCH is written as IDSBN', we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d256f60d3a7070db62a1a236322099250409da9560dc9a7501eee0ae5a2e18a.png] 

Similarly, for '**APRIL**', we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e4c5ac98ae03bfdec7d3d8a17e1e60cd6a9024c078912f143e0e6e55ae04a69.png] 

So, '**APRIL**' will be written as '**MJSQB**'. 

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
